Home.title: submitnow
Home.description: Submit URLs to Bing via IndexNow. Your site must host the key file and the submitted URLs must match the same host.

IndexNow.title: Submit URLs to Bing
IndexNow.description: Send a batch request to the Bing IndexNow endpoint.
IndexNow.bingOnlyNote: Submission endpoint: Bing (shared with IndexNow partners).
IndexNow.supportedEnginesNote: One submission reaches all participating search engines.
IndexNow.urlsHelp: One URL per line (or separated by spaces/commas). All URLs must belong to the same host. Maximum 10,000 URLs per request.
IndexNow.keyHelp: Your key must match the key file content hosted on your site (KEY.txt).
IndexNow.hostHelp: If omitted, the host will be inferred from the URL list.
IndexNow.keyLocationHelp: If omitted, it will be set to https://{host}/{key}.txt. The hostname must match the submitted URLs.

errors.invalid_form: Please check the form fields and try again.
errors.invalid_key: Invalid key. Use 8–128 characters (letters, numbers, dashes).
errors.invalid_host: Invalid host. Please enter a domain like example.com.
errors.invalid_key_location: Invalid key file URL. The hostname must match the submitted host.
errors.invalid_urls: Invalid URLs. Please provide valid http(s) URLs.
errors.mixed_hosts: URLs contain multiple hosts. Please submit one host per request.
errors.host_mismatch: Host does not match the URL host. Please leave it empty or match the URLs.
errors.too_many_urls: Too many URLs. Maximum is 10,000 per request.
errors.bing_invalid_request: Bing rejected the request (HTTP {status}). Please check your host, key, and URL list.
errors.bing_invalid_key: Bing rejected the key (HTTP {status}). Ensure your key file is accessible and matches the key.
errors.bing_invalid_url_list: Bing rejected the URL list (HTTP {status}). Ensure URLs are valid and belong to the host.
errors.bing_rate_limited: Rate limited by Bing (HTTP {status}). Please retry later.
errors.bing_error: Bing IndexNow request failed (HTTP {status}). Please verify your key and URL list.
errors.timeout: Request timed out. Please try again.
